entry.content:
If you’re planning a December wedding and dreaming of something elegant, cozy, and seasonally inspired, this red berry winter wedding theme was designed with you in mind. Featuring rich burgundy tones, soft cream textures, and timeless holiday details, these collages bring together stationery, signage, and style inspiration into one cohesive winter wedding vision.

Perfect for DIY December brides, this theme blends romance and simplicity while staying practical and easy to execute.

A Cozy & Elegant December Wedding Aesthetic

December weddings have a charm all their own soft candlelight, layered textures, and rich seasonal colors. This winter wedding theme centers around:

Cream and ivory backdrops

Deep red berry accents

Classic typography

Romantic winter styling

The result is a look that feels festive without being overly themed, making it ideal for couples who want a timeless winter celebration.

Winter Wedding Welcome Sign Inspiration

Your welcome sign is one of the first details guests see, and this red berry winter welcome sign sets the tone beautifully. Displayed on an easel and styled with cream draping, candles, and winter florals, it creates a warm and inviting entrance. This look works especially well for:

Indoor winter 

weddings

Historic venues

Ballrooms and garden rooms

December and holiday weddings

An editable welcome sign template allows DIY brides to personalize names, dates, and locations while keeping the overall aesthetic cohesive.

December Wedding Invitation Flatlay Styling

The invitation collage showcases how stationery can tie your entire wedding vision together. Styled with:

Red ribbon accents

Soft cream fabrics

Winter berries

Jewelry and holiday details

This flatlay demonstrates how a December wedding invitation suite can feel both romantic and elevated. Burgundy and cream invitations are especially popular for winter weddings because they photograph beautifully and complement seasonal décor.

For DIY brides, editable invitation templates make it easy to achieve a professional look without custom design costs.

Winter Bridesmaid Dress Color Inspiration

No December wedding is complete without a stunning bridal party palette. This

 collage features a lineup of bridesmaid dresses in varying shades of red, creating depth while maintaining cohesion.

Red bridesmaid dresses are perfect for:

Winter weddings

Holiday-inspired ceremonies

Classic and romantic wedding styles

Mixing silhouettes while keeping a consistent color palette allows each bridesmaid to feel confident while supporting a unified wedding aesthetic.

entry.title: Cabernet & Brown | Wedding Color Theme
entry.summary: A truly unforgettable wedding begins with a clear vision, one that flows…
entry.content:
A truly unforgettable wedding begins with a clear vision, one that flows seamlessly from the first impression to the final detail. This cabernet-inspired wedding aesthetic brings together timeless architecture, fashion-forward bridal style, and refined stationery to create a celebration that feels both modern and enduring.

The ceremony setting sets the tone with grand white arches, soft greenery, and warm candlelight layered against rich brown linens. This contrast of light and depth creates an atmosphere that feels romantic without being overly traditional, perfect for brides drawn to old-world venues with a contemporary edge. Every element feels intentional, allowing texture and tone to do the heavy lifting.

That same elevated approach carries through the bridal fashion. Neutral gowns in satin and silk, paired with deep cabernet accents, create a cohesive bridal party look that feels editorial yet approachable. The mix of silhouettes keeps the style relaxed and modern, while the unified color palette ensures every photo feels polished and timeless.

Tying it all together is the stationery, the first hint guests receive of what’s to come. Soft neutral paper, classic typography, and refined details echo the elegance of the ceremony and fashion choices. This modern wedding invitation design blends tradition with contemporary styling, setting expectations for a thoughtfully curated celebration from the very beginning.

For the modern bride, this aesthetic proves that cohesion doesn’t mean complexity. By choosing a refined palette and letting quality details shine, you can create a wedding day that feels effortlessly chic, deeply romantic, and unmistakably your own.

entry.title: Practical Bridesmaid Gift Ideas for Every Budget
entry.summary: Need some inspiration on what to get your bridesmaids when you ask…
entry.content:
Need some inspiration on what to get your bridesmaids when you ask them to be apart of your big day? Don't pick out the typical items with "bridesmaid" plastered all over it!  First things first, gifts aren't necessary! Something as simple as a heart felt note is just as amazing as a expensive tote bag.  Here are some ideas that your bridesmaids will be so appreciative of!

Gift Guide 🛒

💰Under $5:

Personalized Notes

A note can be such a great way to tell your besties how much they mean to you and it is so nice on your pocket book! Here is an Etsy template that you can purchase and print off at home or through a local print shop!
 

Hair Ties or Clips

One can never have too many hair ties! Your bridesmaids will find these so helpful, especially as they pack for the bachelorette party and the wedding day! Find these two items on etsy, both under $5! 

 

 

💰💰Under $15:

Wine

Are you surrounded by a bunch of whinos? Then this is a great gift for your bridesmaids. They will appreciate it if you find their favorite kind and apply this custom decal that you can stick on a bottle of wine!
 
 

Jewelry

What a great way to pick out earrings or bracelets that you want them to wear on the wedding day and other occasions after that! This is a great gift that can be used for multiple things! Check out this bracelet from PAVOI on amazon!

 

 

💰💰💰Under $30:

Pajamas or Loungewear

Another multi-use item that your bridesmaids will love is comfy clothes! Your getting ready photos will look cohesive and your bridesmaids get another set of pajamas to have! Here is a couple cute sets on amazon!

 

       

 

Makeup or Products

What are your favorite makeup items or products? There is a good chance that your bridesmaids will like it too! They will be great for events leading up to your big day! Just make sure no new products are used too close to wedding day!

 

 

💰💰💰💰Under $50:

Gift Cards for a Mani-Pedi

What better way to help your bridesmaids prep for the big day or bachelorette party! Treat them to a relaxing day of manicures or pedicures.  It's not only a great gift, but also a great way to bond and celebrate!

 

Perfume

Another amazing gift that they can use for a long time and every-time they use it they will think of you! Perfumes can be spendy, but there are travel sizes, roll-on's, and more options to help fit your budget!

 

 

💰💰💰💰💰Under $100:

Monogrammed Garment Bag

Keep all of your bridesmaid dresses safe and easy to transport with this adorable monogrammed garment bag! Your "I do" crew will appreciate this stylish and useful bag.  Not a bad idea for your groomsmen as well!

 

Hair & Makeup on the Wedding Day

Getting your hair and makeup done for the wedding day can get a little spendy.  I am sure your bridesmaids would love some help with these services.  Especially if they are in multiple weddings this wedding season!
